events.text: U-96 left for her sixth patrol in the North Atlantic.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 2 August 1941 , U-96 left for her sixth patrol in the North Atlantic .

events.text: The U-boat was part of group Greenland.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 12 August , the U-boat was part of group Greenland .

events.subject: self
events.quote: on 28 August , she joined group Prince-Elector .

events.text: U-96 belonged to group Seawolf before returning to base.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In early September , U-96 belonged to group Seawolf before returning to base .

events.text: She entered St.Nazaire after 42 days at sea, without attacking any ships.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 12 September she entered St.Nazaire after 42 days at sea , without attacking any ships .
